blockingFindings.description: Direct neutral renders show the extended under-shorts hem protruding below the overskirt. In crouch the shorts cover more of the thighs, but in sit the shorts remain conspicuously exposed while the overskirt lifts and flares. The intended opaque skort coverage is not yet balanced across neutral and seated poses.

Across front, back, side, and three-quarter views the overskirt still reads as a plain flared skirt; regular pleats are not visually clear. Rear and side surfaces retain broad angular faceting and abrupt folds.

The declared rear waist tab is present as a small protruding shape in the side view, but it is difficult to distinguish as an adjustment tab in the direct rear view and does not read clearly as a garment detail.
The jacket remains mostly plain ivory with a broad diagonal lavender chest panel and minimal visible seam or trim detail in the five views.
No authored UV layout exists for the current weighted garment mesh; UV status remains NOT_CREATED.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
